comment: Flag constraints cases the Go module (pkg/schema_test.go) and the web UI (http/realm-ui/src/utils/constraints.test.ts) both run. schemas: whether a flag of flagType may have the schema as its constraints, and if not, the error. values: whether the schema allows the value, and if not, the error, which names where in the value the first refused part is. Without an error, the case is valid. The server is the authority; the UI checks the same way, with the same words, so that it can explain a value before saving.
